patch:
--- a/rtl/sequence.sv
+++ b/rtl/sequence.sv
@@ -1,14 +1,13 @@
-
 module TopModule(
-	input wire clk  ,
-	input wire rst  ,
-	input wire d1 ,
-	input wire d2 ,
-	input wire sel ,
-	
-	output reg out1,
-	output reg out2,
-	output reg out3
+    input wire clk  ,
+    input wire rst  ,
+    input wire d1 ,
+    input wire d2 ,
+    input wire sel ,
+    
+    output reg out1,
+    output reg out2,
+    output reg out3
 );
 //*************code***********//
 
@@ -24,23 +23,25 @@
     
     always@(*) begin
         case(state)
-            S0     : nstate = d1? S0_5:
-                              d2? S0_5:
+            S0     : nstate = d1 ? S0_5 :
+                              d2 ? S1 :
                               nstate;
-            S0_5   : nstate = d1? S1:
-                              d2? S1_5:
+            S0_5   : nstate = d1 ? S1 :
+                              d2 ? S1_5 :
                               nstate;
-            S1     : nstate = d1? S1_5:
-                              d2? S2:
+            S1     : nstate = d1 ? S1_5 :
+                              d2 ? S2 :
                               nstate;
-            S1_5   : nstate = ~sel? S0:
-                              d1? S2:
-                              d2? S2_5:
+            S1_5   : nstate = ~sel ? S0 :
+                              d1 ? S2 :
+                              d2 ? S2_5 :
                               nstate;
-            S2     : nstate = ~sel? S0:
-                              d1? S2_5:
-                              d2? S3:
+            S2     : nstate = ~sel ? S0 :
+                              d1 ? S2_5 :
+                              d2 ? S3 :
                               nstate;
+            S2_5   : nstate = S0;
+            S3     : nstate = S0;
             default: nstate = S0;
         endcase
     end
